# S05: Tacking attempt detection and live probability UX

**Tacking attempts detected during plotting, live probability displayed in UI, flag reverts on undo**

## What Happened

Flowed is_tacking_attempt through the full response chain: MovementValidator computes it in PlottingState (pivots_used >= 2 AND luffing_ended), ValidMovesResult carries it, controller writes it to session and all three response types (PlottingStarted, HexSelected, UndoComplete), client carries it through signals. GameController computes tacking probability from DataManager.get_tacking_percent using ship maneuverability and current wind speed, passes to PlanningPhaseUI which displays a gold 'Tacking: NN% success' label inside plotting controls. Label hides when is_tacking_attempt is false or plotting controls are hidden. Session._recompute_tracking resets the flag on undo; the controller then sets the authoritative value from the validator. 12 new unit tests cover detection, non-detection edge cases, undo revert, probability lookup, and response serialization.

- [MEM002] (architecture) Movement resolver placement Chose: New MovementResolver class under scripts/server/, symmetric with MovementValidator.. Rationale: Clean separation between plotting (legality) and resolution (execution under simultaneity rules). ShipStateController and MovementPlottingController are the wrong concerns. Rejected: extending ShipStateController (bloats one class); method on plotting controller (session manager, not simulator)..
- [MEM007] (architecture) Resolution playback architecture Chose: Resolver emits a ResolutionLog (per-impulse events + pause-points for prompts); view-side MovementResolutionPlaybackController consumes the log, animates ships hex-by-hex, surfaces prompts via signals.. Rationale: Resolver stays pure-logic and fully testable. Player still gets the simultaneous-resolution drama. Decouples rule logic from animation timing. Rejected: live-animate as resolver steps (entangles concerns); instant resolution (kills drama)..
- [MEM004] (architecture) Resolver granularity Chose: Impulse-by-impulse simulation: 1 MP per ship per impulse, contests checked per impulse.. Rationale: Only granularity that makes contested-hex rules behave correctly in fleet engagements. Full-plot-then-contest breaks pass-through semantics between adjacent ships. Matches Close Action mechanics referenced in docs/..
- [MEM011] (architecture) Treatment of preexisting test failures during M001/S01 Chose: All preexisting failing tests in `make test` (currently 45 failures across test_data_manager_tacking, test_data_manager_speed_change, test_data_manager_ships, test_data_manager_turning) must be fixed before S01 can complete. The S01 verification gate (T03) is no longer "no new regressions"; it is "make test is fully green".. Rationale: User override (`.gsd/OVERRIDES.md`, 2026-05-11T22:22:15Z, applied at M001/S01/T02) changed the slice exit bar from "no regressions vs current baseline" to "all tests pass, even preexisting failures". 
- [MEM010] (convention) DataManager rule-table loaders share a fixed shape: a `_doc` key inside the JSON (excluded from item counts), `load_X_table(file_path) -> bool` (push_warning + return false on missing file, push_error + return false on parse failure, returns true and prints item count on success), and `get_X(...)` lookups that `assert()` valid params (case-insensitive letter args canonicalized to one case), then push_error and return a zero value (0, 0.0, or {}) on any missing key.
- [MEM003] (architecture) Mid-resolution user input pattern Chose: Async/await on Godot signals for contested-hex surrender and bear-off prompts during resolution.. Rationale: Godot-idiomatic, single execution context, no new mini-protocol. Stub-AI prompt answers injected programmatically so deadlock is impossible in single-machine M001. Rejected: mini-session protocol (too heavy for yes/no); explicit state machine (too verbose)..
- [MEM009] (architecture) Test strategy for M001 Chose: Unit tests for rule math + table lookups (existing test_data_manager_* style) plus scenario-driven integration tests under test/fixtures/scenarios/ driving the full validator → resolver → state-update path. Determinism test runs the same fixture twice with the same seed and diffs the ResolutionLog. All run via `make test`.. Rationale: Catches math and wiring bugs. Fixtures double as regression coverage for subsequent milestones. CLI test harness considered and rejected as premature scaffolding..
- [MEM001] (architecture) MovementValidator shape Chose: Single MovementValidator class with broken-out private methods and an internal PlottingState snapshot.. Rationale: All rules consult JSON tables; GDScript favors clear procedural code over plugin-style rule engines; debugging interlocking rule failures is easier in one class with explicit method names. Rule-engine of composable rule classes considered and rejected as premature abstraction..
- [MEM006] (architecture) RNG determinism for scenarios Chose: Single seeded RandomNumberGenerator on GameState; scenario JSON requires integer `seed` field; `-1` means generate a fresh seed at game start (trace-logged). EnvironmentController migrates to consume GameState.rng.. Rationale: Deterministic replay for tests/debugging. Required seed makes scenarios reproducible; -1 sentinel preserves play-variability when authors want it. Single source converges existing RNG fragmentation..
- [MEM008] (architecture) DataManager rule-lookup boundary Chose: All JSON rule-table lookups go through typed DataManager.get_* functions with assert() parameter validation, modeled on load_movement_allowance_table() / get_movement_allowance(). Pattern: load_<table>_table() + get_<table>(typed params) + test/unit/test_data_manager_<table>.gd. Any missing wrapper is added before its consumer is written.. Rationale: Single source of truth for rule lookups; consistent style; catches bad parameters fast; tables are independently testable. 3	## MovementValidator - Calculates valid movement options for ships
4	##
5	## Consults DataManager rule tables for MA, turning, and speed change limits.
6	## Single-ship rules only (no collision/contest detection).
7	
8	var game_state: Node = null
9	var hex_grid: HexGrid = null
10	
11	
12	func _init(p_game_state: Node = null) -> void:
13		game_state = p_game_state if p_game_state else GameState
14		hex_grid = HexGrid.new()
15	
16	
17	## Internal snapshot of computed state during path validation.
18	class PlottingState extends RefCounted:
19		var base_ma: int = 0
20		var remaining_ma: int = 0
21		var min_ma: int = 0
22		var max_ma: int = 0
23		var pivots_used: int = 0
24		var forward_hexes_since_last_pivot: int = 0
25		var last_pivot_direction: MovementTypes.MoveType = MovementTypes.MoveType.NONE
26		var free_pivot_used: bool = false
27		var luffing_ended: bool = false
28		var is_tacking_attempt: bool = false
29		var current_facing: int = 0
30		var current_hex: Vector2i = Vector2i.ZERO
31		var wind_direction: int = 0
32		var wind_speed: int = 0
33		var speed_last_turn: int = 0
34		var maneuverability: String = "a"
35		var speed_type: String = "F/F"
36		var sail_state: String = "MS"
37		var rigging_quality: int = 4

39	
40	func calculate_valid_moves(
41		ship_state: ShipState,
42		current_hex: Vector2i,
43		current_facing: int,
44		path_so_far: Array[MovementTypes.PlotStep]
45	) -> MovementTypes.ValidMovesResult:
46		var ps = _build_plotting_state(ship_state, current_hex, current_facing, path_so_far)
47		var result = MovementTypes.ValidMovesResult.new()
48		result.remaining_ma = ps.remaining_ma
49		result.can_submit = true
50		result.is_tacking_attempt = ps.is_tacking_attempt
51	
52		if ps.luffing_ended:
53			return result
54	
55		if _is_in_irons(ship_state, path_so_far):
56			Trace.trace_log("MovementValidator", "Ship %s in irons — no movement available" % ship_state.ship_id)
57			return result
58	
59		var valid_options = _calculate_real_valid_hexes(ps, ship_state, path_so_far)
60		result.valid_hexes = valid_options
61	
62		return result

71	) -> MovementTypes.HexValidationResult:

73			ship_state, current_hex, current_facing, path_so_far
74		)
75	
76		for valid_hex_option in valid_moves.valid_hexes.get_all_valid_moves():
77			if valid_hex_option.hex == selected_hex:
78				return MovementTypes.HexValidationResult.success(

80					valid_hex_option.metadata
81				)

96	## Build a PlottingState snapshot by replaying the path so far.
97	func _build_plotting_state(
98		ship_state: ShipState,
99		current_hex: Vector2i,
100		current_facing: int,
101		path_so_far: Array[MovementTypes.PlotStep]
102	) -> PlottingState:
103		var ps = PlottingState.new()
104		ps.current_hex = current_hex
105		ps.current_facing = current_facing
106		ps.wind_direction = game_state.environment.wind_direction if game_state.environment else 0
107		ps.wind_speed = game_state.environment.wind_speed if game_state.environment else 2
108		ps.speed_last_turn = ship_state.speed
109		ps.maneuverability = ship_state.ship.maneuverability.to_lower() if ship_state.ship else "a"
110		ps.speed_type = ship_state.ship.speed_type if ship_state.ship else "F/F"
111		ps.sail_state = ship_state.sail_state
112		ps.rigging_quality = ship_state.get_rigging_quality()
113	
114		var accel = DataManager.get_speed_change("acceleration", ps.maneuverability)
115		var decel = DataManager.get_speed_change("deceleration", ps.maneuverability)
116	
117		# Replay path to compute state at current position
118		var replay_facing = ship_state.facing
119		for step in path_so_far:
120			if step.move_type == MovementTypes.MoveType.FORWARD:
121				ps.forward_hexes_since_last_pivot += 1
122			elif step.move_type == MovementTypes.MoveType.PORT or step.move_type == MovementTypes.MoveType.STARBOARD:
123				ps.pivots_used += 1
124				ps.forward_hexes_since_last_pivot = 0
125				ps.last_pivot_direction = step.move_type
126	
127				# Check for luffing: pivot into wind_facing L ends movement
128				var wf_after = hex_grid.get_wind_facing(step.facing, ps.wind_direction)
129				if wf_after == "L":
130					ps.luffing_ended = true
131	
132				# Check for tacking: pivot to L then same direction again
133				if ps.pivots_used >= 2 and ps.luffing_ended:
134					ps.is_tacking_attempt = true
135	
136			replay_facing = step.facing
137	
138		# Calculate MA at current facing
139		var wind_facing = hex_grid.get_wind_facing(current_facing, ps.wind_direction)
140		ps.base_ma = _lookup_ma(ps.speed_type, ps.wind_speed, wind_facing, ps.sail_state, ps.rigging_quality)
141	
142		# Speed range
143		ps.min_ma = max(ps.speed_last_turn - decel, 0)
144		ps.max_ma = min(ps.speed_last_turn + accel, ps.base_ma)
145		if ps.max_ma < ps.min_ma:
146			ps.max_ma = ps.min_ma
147	
148		# If MA is 0 from table, speed range is 0
149		if ps.base_ma == 0:
150			ps.min_ma = 0
151			ps.max_ma = 0
152	
153		# Count MA spent so far
154		var ma_spent = 0
155		var replay_facing2 = ship_state.facing
156		var first_move = true
157		for step in path_so_far:
158			if step.move_type == MovementTypes.MoveType.FORWARD:
159				ma_spent += 1
160				first_move = false
161			elif step.move_type == MovementTypes.MoveType.PORT or step.move_type == MovementTypes.MoveType.STARBOARD:
162				# Check for fast-tack bonus: C→B on first move
163				if first_move:
164					var wf_before = hex_grid.get_wind_facing(replay_facing2, ps.wind_direction)
165					var wf_after = hex_grid.get_wind_facing(step.facing, ps.wind_direction)
166					if wf_before == "C" and wf_after == "B":
167						ps.max_ma += 1
168						Trace.trace_log("MovementValidator", "Fast-tack bonus: C→B first pivot, +1 MA for ship %s" % ship_state.ship_id)
169	
170				# Pivots cost 1 MA, unless it's a free pivot at MA=0
171				var pivot_wind_facing = hex_grid.get_wind_facing(replay_facing2, ps.wind_direction)
172				var pivot_base_ma = _lookup_ma(ps.speed_type, ps.wind_speed, pivot_wind_facing, ps.sail_state, ps.rigging_quality)
173				if pivot_base_ma == 0 or (ps.max_ma - ma_spent) <= 0:
174					if not ps.free_pivot_used:
175						ps.free_pivot_used = true
176					else:
177						ma_spent += 1
178				else:
179					ma_spent += 1
180				first_move = false
181			replay_facing2 = step.facing
182	
183		ps.remaining_ma = max(0, ps.max_ma - ma_spent)
184	
185		return ps
186

188	func _is_in_irons(ship_state: ShipState, path_so_far: Array[MovementTypes.PlotStep]) -> bool:
189		"""Ship at wind_facing=L with speed 0 and no path yet = in irons."""
190		if not path_so_far.is_empty():
191			return false
192		if ship_state.speed != 0:
193			return false
194		var wind_dir = game_state.environment.wind_direction if game_state.environment else 0
195		var wf = hex_grid.get_wind_facing(ship_state.facing, wind_dir)
196		if wf == "L":
197			Trace.trace_log("MovementValidator", "Ship %s is in irons (facing L, speed 0)" % ship_state.ship_id)
198			return true
199		return false
200	
201	
202	func _calculate_real_valid_hexes(
203		ps: PlottingState,
204		ship_state: ShipState,
205		path_so_far: Array[MovementTypes.PlotStep]
206	) -> MovementTypes.ValidNextHexes:
207		var result = MovementTypes.ValidNextHexes.new()
208		var last_step_was_pivot = false
209		if not path_so_far.is_empty():
210			var last_type = path_so_far.back().move_type
211			last_step_was_pivot = (last_type == MovementTypes.MoveType.PORT or last_type == MovementTypes.MoveType.STARBOARD)
212	
213		# Forward move: always available if remaining_ma > 0
214		if ps.remaining_ma > 0:
215			var forward_hex = hex_grid.get_neighbor(ps.current_hex.x, ps.current_hex.y, ps.current_facing)
216			var forward_meta = MovementTypes.MoveMetadata.new(MovementTypes.MoveType.FORWARD, ps.current_facing, 1)
217			result.forward.append(MovementTypes.ValidMove.new(forward_hex, MovementTypes.MoveType.FORWARD, forward_meta))
218	
219		# Pivot rules
220		var can_pivot = true
221		var pivot_cost = 1
222	
223		# No consecutive pivots
224		if last_step_was_pivot:
225			can_pivot = false
226			Trace.trace_log("MovementValidator", "Ship %s: no consecutive pivots" % ship_state.ship_id)
227	
228		# Max 2 pivots per turn
229		if ps.pivots_used >= 2:
230			can_pivot = false
231			Trace.trace_log("MovementValidator", "Ship %s: max 2 pivots reached" % ship_state.ship_id)
232	
233		# Luffing ended movement
234		if ps.luffing_ended:
235			can_pivot = false
236	
237		# Min forward-hex requirement from turning table
238		if can_pivot and ps.pivots_used > 0:
239			var required_forward_port = _get_min_forward_for_pivot(
240				ps, MovementTypes.MoveType.PORT, ship_state
241			)
242			var required_forward_starboard = _get_min_forward_for_pivot(
243				ps, MovementTypes.MoveType.STARBOARD, ship_state
244			)
245			var can_port = ps.forward_hexes_since_last_pivot >= required_forward_port
246			var can_starboard = ps.forward_hexes_since_last_pivot >= required_forward_starboard
247	
248			if can_port or can_starboard:
249				can_pivot = true
250			else:
251				can_pivot = false
252				Trace.trace_log("MovementValidator", "Ship %s: need %d/%d forward hexes before port/starboard pivot (have %d)" % [
253					ship_state.ship_id, required_forward_port, required_forward_starboard, ps.forward_hexes_since_last_pivot
254				])
255	
256			if can_pivot:
257				# Determine cost: free pivot if MA=0 or remaining=0 and not used yet
258				if ps.remaining_ma <= 0:
259					if ps.free_pivot_used:
260						can_pivot = false
261					else:
262						pivot_cost = 0
263	
264				if can_pivot and ps.remaining_ma > 0:
265					pivot_cost = 1
266	
267				_add_pivot_options(result, ps, ship_state, pivot_cost, can_port, can_starboard)
268				return result
269	
270		if can_pivot:
271			# First pivot or no pivot yet — check if MA allows it
272			if ps.remaining_ma <= 0:
273				if ps.free_pivot_used:
274					can_pivot = false
275				else:
276					pivot_cost = 0
277			if can_pivot:
278				_add_pivot_options(result, ps, ship_state, pivot_cost, true, true)
279	
280		return result
281	
282	
283	func _add_pivot_options(
284		result: MovementTypes.ValidNextHexes,
285		ps: PlottingState,
286		ship_state: ShipState,
287		pivot_cost: int,
288		allow_port: bool,
289		allow_starboard: bool
290	) -> void:
291		if allow_port:
292			var port_facing = (ps.current_facing + 5) % 6
293			var port_hex = hex_grid.get_neighbor(ps.current_hex.x, ps.current_hex.y, port_facing)
294			var port_wf = hex_grid.get_wind_facing(port_facing, ps.wind_direction)
295	
296			var port_meta = MovementTypes.MoveMetadata.new(MovementTypes.MoveType.PORT, port_facing, pivot_cost)
297			result.port = MovementTypes.ValidMove.new(port_hex, MovementTypes.MoveType.PORT, port_meta)
298	
299			if port_wf == "L":
300				Trace.trace_log("MovementValidator", "Ship %s: port pivot into luffing (L) — will end movement" % ship_state.ship_id)
301	
302		if allow_starboard:
303			var starboard_facing = (ps.current_facing + 1) % 6
304			var starboard_hex = hex_grid.get_neighbor(ps.current_hex.x, ps.current_hex.y, starboard_facing)
305			var starboard_wf = hex_grid.get_wind_facing(starboard_facing, ps.wind_direction)
306	
307			var starboard_meta = MovementTypes.MoveMetadata.new(MovementTypes.MoveType.STARBOARD, starboard_facing, pivot_cost)
308			result.starboard = MovementTypes.ValidMove.new(starboard_hex, MovementTypes.MoveType.STARBOARD, starboard_meta)
309	
310			if starboard_wf == "L":
311				Trace.trace_log("MovementValidator", "Ship %s: starboard pivot into luffing (L) — will end movement" % ship_state.ship_id)
312	
313	
314	func _get_min_forward_for_pivot(
315		ps: PlottingState,
316		pivot_direction: MovementTypes.MoveType,
317		ship_state: ShipState
318	) -> int:
319		var direction: String
320		if ps.last_pivot_direction == MovementTypes.MoveType.NONE:
321			direction = "same_direction"
322		elif ps.last_pivot_direction == pivot_direction:
323			direction = "same_direction"
324		else:
325			direction = "opposite_direction"
326	
327		var speed = ps.speed_last_turn
328		if speed <= 0:
329			speed = 1
330		var min_fwd = DataManager.get_min_heading_change_movement_required(
331			direction, speed, ps.maneuverability
332		)
333		return max(1, min_fwd)
334	
335	
336	func _lookup_ma(speed_type: String, wind_speed: int, wind_facing: String, sail_state: String, rigging_quality: int) -> int:
337		if wind_facing == "L":
338			return 0
339		return DataManager.get_movement_allowance(
340			speed_type, wind_speed, wind_facing, sail_state.to_lower(), rigging_quality
341		)

tasks.title: Implement tacking roll and in-irons escape in MovementResolver
tasks.description:
Extend MovementResolver to handle tacking and in-irons cases before the impulse loop.

**Tacking roll** (when ShipState.tacking == true AND plot contains a tack — is_tacking_attempt):
1. Look up base probability: DataManager.get_tacking_percent(ship.maneuverability, wind_speed)
2. Calculate DRMs per docs/02-game-rules.md section 2.1: +0.2 per rigging section lost, +0.1 if facing L, +0.1 if towing, +0.3 if reversing tack, +0.3 if rudder_health <= 0 (skip rudder for M001 — not tracked yet). The DRM is a penalty subtracted from the success threshold.
3. Roll: game_state.rng.randf(). If roll <= (base_probability - total_drm), tack succeeds.
4. Success: ship continues plotted path from the post-tack facing (past the L pivot). Emit tack_success event.
5. Failure: ship stops at the L-facing hex, immobilized=true for this turn, speed=0. Emit tack_failure event. No further impulses for this ship.

**In-irons escape** (ship at speed=0, facing L, no tacking attempt — was already in irons from prior turn):
1. Same tacking_table probability lookup.
2. Roll: game_state.rng.randf(). If roll <= probability, ship escapes — may execute plotted path.
3. Failure: ship remains immobilized, no movement. Emit in_irons_escape_failure.

Note: The is_tacking_attempt flag is set during plotting (S05) and stored on ShipState.tacking. The plotted path for a tacking ship includes the two consecutive pivots through L. On tack success, the resolver walks the full path. On tack failure, the resolver finds the L-facing step and stops there.

Trace.trace_log all roll inputs, thresholds, DRMs, and outcomes.
